verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਮਸ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadheau aaudhoot hoi taamas a(n)dhar jog na jaanai|

en.bdb: Though Mahadev was an ascetic of high order but being full of ignorance he could not even identify yoga.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰੋ ਭੂਤ ਕੁਸੂਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੇਤ੍ਰਪਾਲ ਬੇਤਾਲ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhairo bhoot kusoot vich khetrapaal betaal dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: He merely subordinated Bhairav, ghosts, Ksetrapals, and baitals (all malignant spirits).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਮੜ੍ਹੀ ਮਸਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ak dhatooraa khaavanaa raatee vaasaa maRhee masaanai|

en.bdb: He would eat akk ( a wild plant of sandy region – calotropis procera) and datura and lived in cemetery at night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਨੈ ਹਾਥੀ ਸੀਹ ਖਲ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: painai haathee seeh khal ddauroo vai karai hairaanai|

en.bdb: He would wear the lion or elephant skin and would make people restive by playing on damaru (tabor).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾਇਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: naathaa naath sadhaidhaa hoi anaath na har ra(n)g maanai|

en.bdb: He was known as the nath (yogi) of the naths but never becoming masterless (anath) or humble did he remember God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਠਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭੋਗ ਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: siraTh sa(n)ghaarai taamasee jog na bhog na jugat pachhaanai|

en.bdb: His main task was to destroy world malignantly. He would not understand the technique of enjoyment and repudiation (yoga).
One attains the fruits of pleasure be becoming a gurmukh a gurmukh and being in the holy congregation.
